description: This file defines the HomePage entity class using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models a database table 'ohrm_home_page' with properties such as id, action, enableClass, priority, and a relation to the UserRole entity. The class includes getters and setters for its properties and is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically related to handling home page configurations for user roles.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: Entity class representing a home page configuration, with properties for id, action, enableClass, priority, and user role, along with corresponding getters and setters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the home page record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the home page record.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with the home page entry.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action associated with the home page entry.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class used to enable styling or behavior.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class used for enabling styling or behavior.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the home page entry.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the home page entry.
